sourceTitle: The Jest Book The Choicest Anecdotes and Sayings
description: "The Jest Book" by Mark Lemon is a collection of humorous anecdotes and sayings written in the mid-19th century. The work compiles a selection of jokes, clever retorts, and amusing tales, many of which date back centuries, showcasing the timeless nature of wit and humor.
